mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are 64 degrees with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a Third Quarter moon tonight, with an overnight low dropping to 56 degrees and rain predicted. The ISS passes overhead tonight, though you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, asphalt repair work is scheduled to begin on Monday, November 9th, affecting areas near North Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street. Additionally, Verona welcomed Liz Gay as the new EMS Deputy Chief for Fitch-Rona EMS.

For local events today, options include Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, Paddy Mac's will host live music and Lake Lou-ee will host Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher.

In the weekly police recap, on Sunday at 5:34 AM, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped at the intersection, arresting a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I first offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel.
Culver's is now closed for the evening after serving Turtle Cheesecake today. Be sure to stop by tomorrow at 10:00 AM when they open with tomorrow's flavor, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
